title: Pan-Seared Bao with Sweet Potato Hash
description: A delicious breakfast or brunch dish featuring pan-seared bao with a crispy sweet potato hash and a hint of Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced sweet potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Kenyan spices and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, pan-fry the bao pieces in the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil until golden brown.
Serve the pan-seared bao on top of the sweet potato hash.
Garnish with chopped green onions and fresh cilantro, if desired.
